bio: Game development student based in Barcelona, focused on gameplay programming, interactive systems, and player-first prototypes.
aboutLong: I am studying video game development at Universitat de Barcelona / ENTI, where I work on playable prototypes, team projects, and practical game design exercises. My focus is the intersection between gameplay code, systems thinking, and readable player feedback: mechanics that are clear, responsive, and fun to iterate on. I am especially interested in gameplay programming, level and puzzle logic, rapid prototyping, and collaborative development with artists and designers.
